entities.summary: Humberto Salvador Guerra was an Ecuadorian writer, lawyer, and psychoanalyst. In his early works, he was—alongside Pablo Palacio—a representative of the avant-garde movement in Ecuador, publishing books such as En la ciudad he perdido una novela... (1930). His writing later shifted toward the trend of social realism.
